known_limitations: ResetMana_ClearsPostCastRegenDelayTimerState uses reflection on the private `timeSinceLastSpend` field because ResetMana always also sets CurrentMana to MaxMana, and Tick() short-circuits whenever CurrentMana >= MaxMana, so the timer-clearing half of AC-001 has no observable effect through the public Spend/Tick/CurrentMana surface alone; this mirrors the project's existing reflection-based private-member test pattern in the Editor test suite but is tied to the current field name.

PlayerManaUI tests wire the private `mana`/`fillImage`/`deniedFlashDuration` serialized fields via reflection (no public setters exist) and toggle `enabled` off/on so OnEnable re-subscribes to CastDenied with the correct mana reference, since the initial AddComponent-triggered OnEnable runs before the fields are set.

PlayerMana_PublicApiSurface_OnlyOwnsManaAndRegenDelayState (AC-003) is a regression-only public-surface lock; it cannot prove no private spell-local state was ever added to PlayerMana, only that its public contract has not grown to expose such state.

No Unity Editor, compiler, or test runner was executed; compilation and pass/fail status are unverified by me and require an actual Unity Test Runner run plus human Play Mode/visual confirmation of the mana-denied flash readability.
